name: database
description: Database implementation and safety for relational stores: a database-engineer worker that applies schema, migration, indexing and pooling work, and a PreToolUse guard that asks for confirmation before a destructive statement (DROP/TRUNCATE/unqualified DELETE-UPDATE) lands. Reviewing is /sql:review's job (install sql alongside); the rubric lives in its sql-best-practices skill; dialect audits in mariadb.
